// diagnostic

E2408

`#Flatten` on `{field}` needs a struct-typed field.

What

`#Flatten` on `{field}` needs a struct-typed field.

Why

Flatten splices another struct's keys into this object (D-SERDE5), so the field must itself be a `#Codable` struct — not a primitive, list, or map.

Fix

Give `{field}` a `#Codable` struct type, or drop `#Flatten`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2408: tests/ui/serde_flatten_not_struct.stderr.

Error [E2408]: `#[Flatten]` on `count` needs a struct-typed field
  --> tests/ui/serde_flatten_not_struct.jet:5:14
    |
  5 |     #Flatten count: Int
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: flatten splices another struct's keys into this object, so the field must be a `#[Codable]` struct — not a primitive, list, or map
 Fix: give `count` a `#[Codable]` struct type, or drop `#[Flatten]`
